rawFulfillRandomWords(uint256,uint256[]).details: Cheap callback: no transfers, circuit execution or untrusted external calls.

requestDraw(uint256).details: VRF subscription costs are paid separately, never taken from the BEM pool.

settle(uint256).details: Transfer to dead address FIRST, then organizer, then winner, atomically. This locks tokens at the dead address; it does NOT reduce BEM totalSupply().

authorizeSeries().notice: One-time activation via the fixed container's execute method. No NFT transfer/approval, revocation, or post-randomness holder veto exists.

burnUnclaimed(uint256).notice: After the fixed claim deadline, anyone can move only this failed round's unclaimed principal to the dead address. No other round is touched.

buy(uint256,uint32).notice: Assign the lowest remaining unsold ticket numbers in this round. Explicit selection and automatic allocation share the same payment and draw rules.

buySelected(uint256,uint16[]).notice: Inputs are zero-based, strictly ascending and unique. Requested unsold tickets are reserved first; sold requests move forward to the next free ticket, wrapping from9999 to0. Events report the actual allocation. Invalid input, insufficient remaining supply or payment failure reverts all.

openRefunds(uint256).notice: Fixed timeout refunds only BEFORE requesting randomness. After request, funds wait for that exact result and live circuit execution, even if an external dependency is unavailable. No selective cancellation.

previewAttempt(uint256,uint256,uint32).notice: Public replay of any attempt. Settlement always uses the stored cursor. The first 20 attempts use disjoint VRF bits. Later attempts use a fixed, domain-separated cryptographic expansion of the SAME verified words.

refund(uint256,address).notice: Anyone can pay gas to refund a participant; money always goes to that participant.

refundClaimDeadline(uint256).notice: Fixed deadline, even when refunds are opened late by another caller.

requestDraw(uint256).notice: Anyone may request exactly one draw for a locked round.

runCircuit2075(uint16).notice: MUST call the real circuit. Known arithmetic is a validation guard, not a substitute for the call. Inputs and outputs use little-endian bytes.

settle(uint256).notice: Anyone may settle; recipients and amounts cannot be chosen by the caller.

ticketOwner(uint256,uint32).notice: Exact zero-based ticket ownership. Unsold tickets return zero. Ownership remains a historical record after refund; tickets cannot be resold.

ticketWords(uint256,uint16,uint16).notice: Up to 625 words. Each has 16 low-to-high uint16 buyer IDs; zero=unsold.

userdoc.notice: Fixed 100 BEM / 10000 tickets. Production denomination. BEHEMOTH2075 computes and authorizes; TapeOut13061 receives the organizer1%. Funding24h; self-service refunds for24h; unclaimed principal then goes to dead.
